title: FREE STARBUCKS GIFT CARD FOR MOMS? YES PLEASE!
description: This holiday season, indulge a little.   Book an eye exam for you or a loved one at http://www.kleinburgvisioncentre.com/ and be treated with a FREE Starbucks gift card!

asr.full_text: Hi moms, I'm Dr. Nishi Kular. I'm Dr. Neera Kular. Now we know the holiday season can be very exciting but also very tiring. We wanna give you a break by giving your free Starbucks gift card when you book an eye exam for yourself or anyone in your family. We're Kleinberg Vision Center. We're local, we're convenient and we're very friendly. We're an optometry and optical store with exceptional eye care and a large variety of designer frames. So what are you waiting for? Click on the link or give us a call to get started. Don't wait though! This offer is only valid for a limited number of Starbucks Gift Cards Click on the link to book your time! Merry Christmas, and Happy Holidays! See you soon!
